ground_truth_source: The CVE each target's vulhub environment documents (github.com/vulhub/vulhub, master, <vulhub_env>/docker-compose.yml uses this image tag).

targets.note: The vulhub env builds on this image to enable the exploitable config; the benchmark scans the published base image unmodified (version detection does not depend on that config).
The vulhub env builds on this image to enable HTTP PUT (readonly=false); the benchmark scans the published base image unmodified.
The vulhub env mounts a config listening on 8080; the base image listens on 80.

pre_registered_risks: nginx: nmap emits the CPE vendor 'igor_sysoev', NVD indexes nginx under 'f5' / 'nginx'; a miss is likely.
jetty: nmap's version string (e.g. 9.4.37.v20210219) may not match NVD's CPE version form; a miss is possible.
mysql: nmap emits vendor 'mysql', newer NVD entries use 'oracle'; partial or full miss is possible.
selection_changes_before_first_scan: couchdb 2.1.0 (CVE-2017-12635) was dropped: its port 5984 is not in nmap's top-1000, and VulnSight's nmap path only scans the top-1000. Replaced with mysql 5.5.23 (port 3306, in top-1000). Decided from a port-list check, not from any scan result.
excluded: samba: nmap reports a version range ('3.X - 4.X'), not an exact version.
phpmyadmin: its version is not visible to nmap -sV.
Metasploitable 2: not in the user's chosen scope for this phase (vulhub only).
